lro-lcross-2009.name: Shared ride with LRO
lro-lcross-2009.precedent: LCROSS, the secondary payload on LRO's Atlas V 401 (AV-020), launched June 18, 2009 from Cape Canaveral SLC-41

secondarySlot_kg.source: NASA NTRS 20100028203 — D. Andrews (LCROSS project manager), "LCROSS: A High-Return, Small Satellite Mission": the LRO secondary payload "could weigh no more than 1000 kg (fuelled)" (the 1000 kg mass budget allotted to the secondary payload)

primaryMass_kg.source: NASA Science: LRO mission details (spacecraft mass 4,000 pounds, 1,850 kilograms; Atlas V 401 AV-020, June 18, 2009). NSSDC lists about 1,846 kg
